_note: THE RUN (src/game/courses/basic.ts builds it; Milestone 636). The owner, 2026-10-17: "WE NEED TO REDO THE 3 COURSES AGAIN AND MAKE THEM MUCH LONGER TO COMPENSATE WITH THE NEW DISTANCES AND MOVEMENT SPEED FOR EVERYTHING. No more ziplines ... you can remove 1 of the 'the runs' and the other run just align it to today's movement speed". The timed run behind the range's left-hand gate, rebuilt out and back as the tutorial is: out up the left half (`out`, x across in course coordinates, facing +z) to the turn, across the far end (turnZ to farZ), and back down the other half (`back`, facing -z) to the finish line `finishAt` metres inside its last door, by the start. Two bays, as one bay to the city's edge was too short for rooms sized to today's reach (the old seven rooms were 120 m; this is about 340 m). Every gate here was measured on the real controller, armed (the run hands you two pistols): tools/checks/sk-run.ts drives it through this geometry, each room passed with its move and not with the one before it. Walls are `wallH`, over the 8 m a climb reaches. A slick face (range.ts Solid.slick) takes no wall run and no climb; a mantle still takes its top. Metres.
_breach: Room 1: a low wall `h` high and `d` deep across the bay `at` metres in, jumped at a sprint, and a cover box past it.
_vent: Room 2: a block `depth` deep across the bay `at` metres in, full height, with a slot `slot` high and `slotW` wide straight ahead of the door: crouched (1.19 m) fits, standing (1.83 m) does not, so a slide takes you through at speed.
_climb: Room 3: a wall `height` high and `depth` deep across the bay `at` metres in, climbed (a climb reaches 8 m), and a ramp down its far side at `slope` degrees to slide. A double jump and a mantle top out under 5.5 m: sk-run proves no jump at any timing tops this wall without the climb.
_gap: Room 4: a step, a deck `runUp` long, a pit `pit` across, a landing deck to the door. Measured on this deck (scratch sweep 2026-10-18, armed, from the door at rest): one jump crosses 11 m from 1 of 7 take-offs and 12 m from none; the double jump crosses 13 m from 43 of 63 jump-and-second-jump timings, 15 m from 33, 16 m from 29 (under half). So 13 m: no single jump, the double jump from most timings. A slide jump crosses it too (16.7 m on the flat at a full sprint, reach.json slideJump), the other way the tip names. Its side walls are slick, or a wall run crosses it.
_wallRun: Room 5: a step, a deck, a pit `pit` long, a landing deck `landing` long, and the turn. Measured (the same sweep): no double jump crosses 24 m or more at any timing, a slide into a double jump included (5 of 63 at 22 m); a wall run along the bay's outer wall crosses 44 m from every take-off tried and none at 48. 32 m sits between the two with room each side. The outer wall is lit `lit`.
_superglide: Room 6, the first of the way back: the tutorial's superglide ledge as it is (tutorial.json superglide: `runUp` of floor to a 3.8 m slick ledge 0.6 m deep, and its gap from reach.json superglide, measured off that ledge), a landing deck `landing` long at the ledge's height, then the floor to the door. The ledge and the deck are plain as the tutorial's were when measured, so a jump at either climbs its face. Here the gap's floor is no hazard: drop in, and a climb or a double jump takes the landing deck's face, the slow way. Its side walls are slick.
_crossfire: Room 7: `walkers` dummies walking to and fro across the bay (each [x, z, dx, period]: from x, dx metres across and back in 2 x period seconds), and pillars 1.2 m square and `pillarH` high between their lines ([x, z]).
_high: Room 8: a slick platform `height` high and `depth` deep across the bay `at` metres in (one jump does not reach its top, the double jump does: the tutorial's high-ground platform measured the same, armed), and a screen `screenH` high `screenAt` metres in, across the bay but a `gapW` gap by the middle wall. The dummies stand behind the screen: hidden from the floor, in sight from the platform's top (sk-run checks both).
_final: Room 9: the final sprint, holstered (15% faster), the finish line `finishAt` metres from its last door.
_ranks: The rank times, seconds (S, A, B, C past B). S is the route's time as tools/checks/sk-run.ts runs it end to end on the controller, every move the fastest the room's tip names, plus `shot` seconds a dummy to aim and fire; A and B are S times `a` and `b`. sk-run fails if S is more than 10% off what it measures. Measured 2026-10-18: the route 29.65 s (the rooms entered at 0.76, 2.62, 4.28, 7.19, 9.52, 15.95, 19.83, 22.90 and 27.04 s), and 27 dummies, 40.4 s.
